interactions.text: The sites have changed so following the directions of this course were very confusing and hard to understand. The update from Data Science Experience to IBM Watson studio did not relate to the video demonstrated in this class

interactions.author: Amiya R B
interactions.text: I think the trainer just read out some material prepared by him. concepts are uncleared to me. bad experience

interactions.author: srijanapuri
interactions.text: I learned many new things, ideas, knowledge,and skills from this course.I am very much thankful to both professors for teaching about all of those interesting lessons,providing many more things. now, I am able to give all of the answers frequently which I learned from this beneficial course.

interactions.author: Carlo C
interactions.text: Well done!!! The course is interesting and well organized.Lack of Pyton knowledge from my side is sometimes critical to solve some exercises...It's my intention, as soon as I'lI have complete the three couses, to attend a Pyton course to complete my preparation.

interactions.author: Cat-Tuong N
interactions.text: Challenging and fun course. The number of topics is on the high side. Maybe break this into 2 courses? The programming assignments are fun. You will need to go to discussion forum to solve often encountered problems.

interactions.author: Sebastien C
interactions.text: Content was interestind and provided good theoretical overview. Exercices where you just have to fill in some line of codes are not usefull.

interactions.author: Julien P
interactions.text: Great to put into action the theoretical knowledge acquired in the previous 8 classes. What could be improved? The peer-rating system can be very slow. A common practice is to go on the forum to beg for a rating by another learner. This can be tiring.

insights: Los estudiantes valoran la aplicación práctica de conocimientos pero reportan frustración con plataformas desactualizadas.
Existe una necesidad de mejorar la claridad en conceptos teóricos y la eficiencia en los sistemas de evaluación entre pares.
La falta de conocimientos previos en herramientas específicas dificulta el progreso en algunos módulos.

generated_assets.title: Entendiendo la Normalización por lotes
generated_assets.body: La normalización por lotes es fundamental para estabilizar y acelerar el entrenamiento de redes neuronales profundas. 1. Identifica las activaciones de la capa. 2. Ajusta los valores para tener media cero. 3. Escala los valores para tener varianza unitaria. 4. Aplica la normalización a lo largo de la dimensión del lote. Ejemplo: En una red, esto evita que los gradientes se desvanezcan o exploten, permitiendo tasas de aprendizaje más altas.

evidence.snippet:
Pregunta: What is batch normalization in neural networks?
Respuesta: Batch normalization is a technique used to normalize the activations of each layer in a neural network by adjusting and scaling them to have zero mean and unit variance, which can accelerate training and improve model performance.

Pregunta: What is the difference between batch normalization and layer normalization in neural networks?
Respuesta: Batch normalization normalizes the activations of each layer across the batch dimension, while layer normalization normalizes the activations across the feature dimension, making it more suitable for recurrent neural networks and other architectures with variable-length sequences.

Pregunta: What is the exploration-exploitation trade-off in reinforcement learning?
Respuesta: The exploration-exploitation trade-off refers to the dilemma faced by agents in balancing the need to explore new options with the desire to exploit known options for immediate rewards, to achieve long-term optimal performance.

Pregunta: What is the exploration-exploitation dilemma in reinforcement learning?
Respuesta: The exploration-exploitation dilemma refers to the challenge faced by agents in balancing the need to explore new actions or states to discover optimal policies with the desire to exploit known actions or states for immediate rewards, to achieve long-term optimal performance.
